concerns.location: tasks.md:Dependencies and requirement coverage table; T006/T007
concerns.text: SC-004 (odds ratio ≥ 1.5 with FDR-corrected p ≤ 0.05 for enrichment of risk genes in rewired hubs) has no task verification. T006 computes OR and FDR p-values but its Verification clause only checks CSV columns; T007's verification checks SC-003 (empirical p ≤ 0.05) and mentions a power analysis 'for OR ≥ 1.5 detection' but never requires the SC-004 pass criterion. The coverage table lists no SC-004 row. An implementer cannot know SC-004 must be met and reported.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T003 bullet 'run one hypergeometric enrichment test with 100 permutations'
concerns.text: T003's thin end-to-end slice uses 100 permutations, below FR-006's ≥ 1,000 minimum. Acceptable as an explicit thin-slice exception, but neither T003 nor the coverage table flags this as a deliberate deviation — add a note (e.g., 'thin-slice exception; full-scale ≥ 5,000 in T007') so the FR-006 mapping is unambiguous.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T002 Verification; plan.md:Project Structure tests/ tree
concerns.text: Plan.md specifies unit tests test_grn.py, test_enrichment.py, contract test_schemas.py, and integration test_end_to_end.py, but tasks only name 'pytest code/tests/test_preprocess.py' (T002) and a generic 'pytest code/tests/' re-run (T010). No task creates the GRN, enrichment, schema-contract, or end-to-end tests from the plan's structure. Add them (e.g., to T004/T006/T003 verification clauses) or note the consolidated equivalent.
